# Scheduler Safety Checklist: Task Pipeline Engine and Declarative Routing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-004 scheduler safety requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and objectively implementable.
**Created**: 2026-05-01
**Feature**: specs/004-task-pipeline-engine/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are flag-off preservation requirements complete for task completion, outbound sync, notifications, subscriptions, ticket counters, activities, and no successor creation? [Completeness, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are flag-on null-default requirements complete for unbound tasks, empty advancement-driving chain fields, slug-only templates, and downstream-metadata-only templates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all live non-`done` to `done` terminal-success surfaces named for advancement coverage: Aegis review approval, operator quality-review approval, bulk task update, and detail task update? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Verification Strategy]
- [ ] CHK004 Are manual and API completion requirements complete enough to preserve allowed completion paths while requiring shared chain advancement for eligible pipeline-bound transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK005 Are scheduler safety requirements complete for duplicate-successor prevention through runtime idempotency plus the `idx_tasks_one_successor_per_parent` partial unique index backstop? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-011, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK006 Are routing-budget overrun requirements complete for terminal-success preservation, operator-visible activity metadata, exact reason code, and no successor creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Routing Rule Evaluation Safety Profile]
- [ ] CHK007 Are successor creation requirements complete in requiring exactly one `createTask()` call, inherited lineage/workspace/project metadata, source-profile defaults, and post-commit outbound sync handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-022a, Plan §Summary]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "advancement-driving chain metadata" objectively defined so scheduler behavior is unchanged for non-driving template fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the `advanceTaskChain` trigger boundary clear that it applies to non-`done` to `done` transitions only, not ordinary edits to already terminal tasks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the routing-budget stall reason code specified as the exact literal `task_pipeline_routing_budget_exceeded` in activity `data.reason_code`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Routing Rule Evaluation Safety Profile]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the one-successor invariant clear that only non-null `parent_task_id` values are unique, while root tasks without parents remain unrestricted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the "createTask exactly once" requirement clear enough to rule out parallel direct inserts or duplicate helper calls during successor creation and retry recovery? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK013 Are scheduler-facing activity requirements clear about storing stable machine-readable metadata without secrets, full corrected output, parsed output, or routing traces? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-031]
